scripts.build-prod:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-prod:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-prod
scripts.build-dev:darwin: pnpm run buildBinary-dev:darwin && pnpm run esbuild-dev && pnpm run build-types
scripts.buildBinary-prod:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/MacFrontmostObserver' ]; then rm bin/MacFrontmostObserver; fi && swift build -c release --package-path src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver && cp src/swift/MacFrontmostObserver/.build/release/MacFrontmostObserver bin/MacFrontmostObserver && shasum -a 256 bin/MacFrontmostObserver > dist/MacFrontmostObserver.sha256
scripts.buildBinary-dev:darwin: if [ -f 'bin/dev/turiya' ]; then rm bin/dev/turiya; fi && xcodebuild -project src/swift/turiya/turiya.xcodeproj -scheme turiya -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath src/swift/turiya/build  && cp src/swift/turiya/build/Build/Products/Debug/turiya bin/dev/turiya && shasum -a 256 bin/dev/turiya > dist/turiya.sha256
